description:
Welcome to the official Pocket Cosmos channel!

Explain mind-bending astrophysics and spacetime paradoxes using everyday analogies and gentle stick figures.
Clear, visual, research-backed explainers crafted for space lovers, students, science fiction thinkers, and curious cosmologists.

Core topics: Astrophysics, black holes, quantum paradoxes & spacetime explained in Feynman style.
